mission: Validate whether provisional smaller-model RoPE theta/base evidence transfers to the MODEL-197-selected 10M context without introducing positional-encoding alternatives.

model117.reason_summary: theta 5000, 10000 and 20000 were effectively tied through 512; differences in held-out BPB, recurrence probes, gradients, attention/logit scales and cache parity were numerically negligible, so changing model identity was not justified
model117.explicit_1024_rule: theta=10000 may be inherited only as provisional incumbent at 1024 and requires dedicated 1K training/evaluation qualification

model197.required_output: selected 10M context from the controlled 256/512/1024 context-transfer experiment
checks_performed: GitHub branch search for 197 and model197
model197.result: No MODEL-197 durable result was discoverable; selected context therefore cannot be inferred without violating the mission.

observed_10m_spec_reference.note: ModelSpec support for 1024 is not evidence that MODEL-197 selected 1024.

candidate_set.reason: MODEL-117 retained the incumbent; MODEL-198 is therefore a transfer verification, not a reopened theta sweep.

preregistered_transfer_verification.activation_condition: A durable MODEL-197 result must identify one selected context in {256, 512, 1024} and provide exact model/data/token-budget identities needed for a matched transfer run.
preregistered_transfer_verification.seed_policy: Run all three seeds for transfer robustness. Multiple seeds are mandatory for any replacement decision; no replacement candidate currently exists.

training.initialization: identical to the corresponding MODEL-197 10M seed initialization
training.optimizer_and_batch_geometry: inherit MODEL-197 unchanged unless MODEL-197 explicitly delegates them to an accepted incumbent

decision_rule.pass: Across the preregistered seeds, theta=10000 trains/evaluates without nonfinite failure, normal held-out BPB is reproducible under the MODEL-197 recipe, dependency-distance probes show no transfer-specific positional pathology at the selected context, attention/logit scales remain finite and non-explosive, and first-party cached/stateless inference parity stays within the repository's accepted numerical tolerance.
decision_rule.fail: Any repeatable transfer-specific positional pathology, nonfinite behavior, or cache/stateless parity violation blocks closure and requires a new explicitly scoped positional-encoding experiment; it does not authorize an unpreregistered theta sweep.
decision_rule.replacement: Not applicable unless later evidence names one evidence-supported successor. A replacement may not be selected from a one-seed result.

current_decision.reason: The selected 10M context is a required controlled variable. Inferring it from ModelSpec max_seq_len, RoPE mathematics, or earlier context-readiness work would violate the experiment contract.

not_tested: 10M transfer training at MODEL-197 selected context
10M normal held-out BPB under the selected context recipe
10M dependency-distance probes under the selected context recipe
10M cached/stateless parity under the selected context recipe
